facts.text: I received a sales email about not hiring a Development Director.
I asked what the sales email does well.
I assumed that someone booked a conversation with me based on the email.
I asked what confirmation email I would send after someone booked a conversation.
I asked what prep I might ask them to do before our conversation.
I asked what questions I might ask them to mull over before our conversation.
I asked what data I might ask them to review or have on hand prior to our conversation.
I want a 30-minute conversation agenda with time allotments where the sales person listens intently.
I want the agenda to lead to the sales person saying yes to conducting a Fundraising Zen Assessment as an upsell.
I asked to turn the agenda into a conversation script workflow.

events.text: User received a sales email titled "Don't hire a Development Director".
User requested a 30-minute conversation agenda for an upsell to conduct a Fundraising Zen Assessment.
